# kion_account (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Kion Accounts. Returns every account matching the supplied filter blocks (all accounts when no filter is given).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_account" "example" {
  # filter {
  #   name   = "example"
  #   regex  = false
  #   values = []
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) Filter results by attribute. Multiple filter blocks are AND'd; values within a single filter are OR'd. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `list` (Attributes List) This is where Kion makes the discovered data available as a list of resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--list))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name whose values you wish to filter by. Supports dotted paths (e.g. "owner.id") to traverse nested objects.
- `values` (List of String) The values of the field name you specified. A row matches if its field equals any of these values.

Optional:

- `regex` (Boolean) When true, the values are treated as regular expressions instead of exact matches.


<a id="nestedatt--list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `list`

Read-Only:

- `account_alias` (String)
- `account_number` (String)
- `account_type_id` (Number)
- `car_external_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `deleted_at` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `include_linked_account_spend` (Boolean)
- `linked_account_number` (String)
- `linked_role` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
- `service_external_id` (String)
- `skip_access_checking` (Boolean)
- `start_datecode` (String)
- `use_org_account_info` (Boolean)
